resources.string: These rules are your own note about what this agent is expected to ask for. They approve nothing and refuse nothing. You approve every request by hand here and again in your wallet, whether the rules match it or not.
Nothing is checked. Every request from this connection is shown as under restrictions, with the reason that no rules are configured.
Nothing is checked any more. Saving removes this connection\'s rules.
May ask for nothing at all.
At most %1$s of %2$s a day, counted from what went through this app.
Not checked: %1$s. A request that matches everything above still says nothing about these.
Allowed and under restrictions both need your hand on the wallet. Neither is an approval, and neither stops anything.
Only these actions may be asked for
Not checked. This connection may ask for any kind of action, and the review says the kind of action was not covered.
Checked. A kind of action that is not ticked is outside the rules.
Nothing is ticked, so every request is outside the rules. That is a rule, not a blank.
Not checked. Any asset may move. The thresholds below still apply to the assets they name.
Checked. An asset that is not listed is outside the rules.
Nothing is listed, so no asset may move. That is a rule, not a blank.
No asset listed. Add one to set a threshold for it.
Most per request, in base units
Most per day, in base units
No threshold. Blank is not a threshold of zero.
Type a plain number, such as 1.5. No sign, no exponent, no spaces and no commas.
Larger than the largest amount a transfer can carry, which is %1$s base units.
A threshold of zero is not a rule. To allow nothing, leave the asset off the list.
The daily threshold is below the per-request one, so the per-request one could never be reached.
This app cannot establish how many decimal places a mint has without a transaction that carries it, so a token\'s thresholds are typed in that mint\'s own base units.
Only these wallets may receive funds
Not checked. Funds may go anywhere, and the review says the recipient was not covered.
Checked. A payment to a wallet that is not listed is outside the rules.
Nothing is listed, so no wallet may be paid. That is a rule, not a blank.
Write the wallet that owns the funds, never a token account. The phone works the owner out of the transaction itself.
Only these programs may be called
Not checked. The transaction may call anything, and the review says the programs were not covered.
Checked. A transaction that calls a program which is not listed is outside the rules.
Nothing is listed, so no program may be called. That is a rule, not a blank.
Every program the transaction calls is checked, the compute budget program included.
Not a Solana address. An address is base58 for 32 bytes.
Rules removed. This connection has none.
Could not save. The rules on this phone are unchanged.
What you changed here has not been saved.
Rules are stored for this connection and this app cannot read the file.
Rules are stored for this connection by a later version of this app. Showing them here would show fewer rules than were set.
The stored rules name something this version has no name for.
Every request from this connection is shown as under restrictions until this is settled. Starting over replaces what is stored, and nothing here can show you what you are replacing.
